newsitem.title: USA: Lakehead Pipe Line buys Hartsdale Terminal.
newsitem.headline: Lakehead Pipe Line buys Hartsdale Terminal.

text.p: Lakehead Pipe Line Partners LP said Thursday it bought the Hartsdale Terminal from Laketon Refining Corp of Indianapolis, Ind. Terms were not disclosed.
The terminal, adjacent to the partnership's Griffith, Ind. terminal, includes nine crude oil tanks totaling 900,000 barrels of storage capacity.
This acquisition will bring the partnership's total crude oil tankage capacity in northern Indiana to about 3.2 million barrels.

President Patrick Daniel said in a statement, "The partnership's 1996 and planned 1998 system expansions will together add 290,000 barrels per day pipeline capacity into the Chicago and U.S. Upper Midwest refinery markets. The acquisition of Hartsdale Terminal complements our expansion efforts by improving the pipeline's operational and storage flexibility."
